title: B2+ · L23 — Advanced collocations
description: Colocaciones avanzadas: raise awareness, address concerns, meet expectations, y otras cadenas de palabras nativas.

questions.prompt: Diseno de una campana de salud mental en tu empresa. Escribes el brief.
questions.question: Which is the correct collocation with 'awareness'?
options: make awareness — literal translation from 'crear conciencia'.
questions.explanation: 'Raise awareness' es LA colocacion nativa estandar (metafora de elevar el nivel de conciencia colectiva). 'Make awareness' es calco directo del espanol 'crear conciencia' — inentendible para nativo. Muy usado en salud publica, campanas sociales, marketing con proposito. Colocacion tipica: 'raise awareness OF X' (nunca 'about' en registro formal). Error hispano frecuente: aplicar 'make' con abstractos porque en espanol 'hacer' es multiuso — en anglo cada abstracto tiene su verbo especifico.
examples: The campaign raised awareness of mental health issues among tech workers under 30. → target especifico
We're raising awareness among small business owners about cybersecurity risks. → registro corporativo

questions.prompt: Explicas a alguien por que tu hijo no se ha despertado con el ruido del vecino.
questions.question: Which collocation is correct for a state of unconsciousness during rest?
options: heavy sleep — describes the person, not the state.
questions.explanation: 'Deep sleep' es la colocacion nativa para el estado (contrasta con 'sueno profundo' donde el espanol usa 'profundo'). Cuidado con la distincion: 'heavy sleeper' describe a la PERSONA que duerme profundamente, no al estado. 'Profound' se usa para efectos, ideas, silencios ('profound impact', 'profound silence'), no para sueno. Error hispano tipico: aplicar 'profound' porque suena etimologicamente similar a 'profundo'. Registro: neutro-conversacional.
examples: The baby is in deep sleep now — try not to make any noise. → estado presente
I'm a heavy sleeper — nothing wakes me, not even the alarm sometimes. → caracterizacion de persona

questions.statement: 'Address concerns' means to acknowledge and respond to worries or issues.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Colocacion corporativa fija: 'address' se combina con concerns/issues/questions/needs/points para significar 'tratar o atender'. NO se usa 'attack' (agresivo) o 'answer' (poco idiomatico para preocupaciones). En crisis PR y HR es la formula estandar. Registro: profesional-formal. Error hispano: usar 'attend to concerns' — funciona pero suena mas hospitalario/servicio; 'address' es lenguaje ejecutivo. Colocacion adicional: 'address the elephant in the room' (tratar lo obvio no dicho).
examples: We need to address the customer's concerns immediately — the escalation is already on Twitter. → urgencia PR
The CEO addressed employee concerns directly in the town hall — no filter, no PR script. → transparencia ejecutiva

questions.prompt: Cierre del trimestre. En el board meeting el CEO presenta los numeros del equipo.
questions.question: Complete: 'The team ___ our expectations this quarter.'
questions.explanation: 'Meet expectations' es LA colocacion nativa estandar. La familia completa: 'meet' (cumplir), 'exceed' (superar), 'fall short of' (quedar cortos), 'manage' (bajar la barra). 'Reach' se usa con conclusions/agreements/goals, no con expectations. 'Arrive at' con conclusions/decisions. 'Touch' no colocaciona con expectations. Error hispano tipico: 'arrive at expectations' — calco de 'llegar a las expectativas' que suena raro en anglo. Registro: neutro-profesional.
examples: The product exceeded all expectations — we projected 10K users, got 50K in three weeks. → sobrecumplimiento
We're on track to meet our Q4 targets if the pipeline holds through November. → forecast ejecutivo

questions.text: The report raises serious concerns and calls into question the assumptions we've been operating under.
questions.explanation: Dos colocaciones academico-corporativas de alto registro: 'raise concerns' + 'call into question'. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'calls into' con /lz/ + /ɪ/ enlazado /kɔːlzɪntə/; 'operating under' con /ŋʌ/ enlazado. Ambas colocaciones aparecen en reports, papers, memos formales. 'Call into question' significa cuestionar la validez, no negar directamente — matiz academico importante. Error hispano: 'put in doubt' es calco incorrecto; correcto es 'call into question' o 'cast doubt on'.
examples: New findings call into question long-held beliefs about how memory works. → registro academico
The audit raises concerns about internal controls in the finance department. → registro corporativo

questions.prompt: Comparas ingles britanico y americano en un contexto profesional.
questions.question: Which verb pairs with 'a decision'?
questions.explanation: Colocacion regional: 'make a decision' es universal y estandar (dominante en US y global business); 'take a decision' es britanico formal, comun en gobierno UK y instituciones europeas influenciadas por UK English. Ambas son correctas gramaticalmente. NUNCA 'do a decision' — calco directo del espanol 'hacer una decision'. Este error hispano es tan comun que los profesores lo cazan al primer intento. Registro: 'take a decision' suena mas formal-institucional; 'make' sirve en cualquier registro.
examples: We need to make a decision by Friday or we'll lose the window. → US/global estandar
The committee will take a decision next week following consultation. → registro UK formal-institucional

questions.prompt: Empareja cada colocacion verb+noun con su traduccion:
questions.explanation: Set esencial de colocaciones verb+noun de alto uso en ingles profesional-academico. La clave: aprender el verbo correcto es imprescindible porque el equivalente literal del espanol casi siempre falla. Errores clasicos: 'do progress' (calco), 'get conclusion' (incorrecto — 'reach' o 'draw'), 'have insight' (funciona en casos, pero 'gain' es mas activo). Registro: neutro-formal, ubicuo en informes, presentaciones, ensayos academicos. Todos aparecen en literatura corporativa diaria.
examples: We're making steady progress on the initiative — small wins, but consistent. → progreso incremental
The study gave us fresh insight into user behavior we hadn't anticipated. → hallazgos

questions.target: The initiative has raised awareness and gained traction, though we still need to address the concerns of key stakeholders.
questions.explanation: Tres colocaciones nativas encadenadas: 'raise awareness', 'gain traction' (ganar impulso/momentum), 'address concerns'. Discurso profesional maduro tipo mid-project review. Ritmo natural: pausa breve tras cada colocacion, tono ascendente en 'though' para senalar transicion. Contracciones: no aplican, registro formal. 'Gain traction' es metafora fisica (fuerza que se agarra) — muy usada en producto y startups. Registro: reporting ejecutivo, sober y bien estructurado.
examples: The pilot gained traction quickly and met expectations across all three regions we tested. → milestone
Once we address remaining concerns, we can reach a decision on rollout timing. → siguiente paso

questions.prompt: Le explicas a tu hijo por que en ingles se dice de manera diferente que en espanol.
questions.question: Which is correct?
options: make homework — calco del espanol 'hacer tarea'.
have homework — describe posesion, no accion.
questions.explanation: 'Do homework/exercise/chores/business/damage' — actividades rutinarias, obligatorias o abstractas. 'Make' se reserva para crear/producir algo tangible o nuevo ('make a cake', 'make a decision', 'make progress'). La distincion 'do vs make' es LA fuente #1 de errores hispanos porque el espanol tiene un solo verbo ('hacer') para ambos. Regla mnemotecnica: 'do' = accion; 'make' = creacion. Colocacion adicional: 'do business with' (hacer negocios con).
examples: I've done my homework on their pricing history before this negotiation. → 'do homework' metaforico = prepararse
She does yoga every morning before checking her inbox — non-negotiable ritual. → actividad rutinaria

questions.statement: 'To pay attention' is a fixed verb-noun collocation — 'make attention' is incorrect.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. 'Pay attention' es colocacion completamente fija — NUNCA 'make attention' (calco del espanol 'hacer atencion' que no existe en anglo). Familia 'pay' + abstractos: 'pay a visit' (visitar formalmente), 'pay respects' (dar el pesame), 'pay a compliment' (elogiar), 'pay heed' (formal, prestar atencion). Todas fossilized. Error hispano tipico y persistente incluso en niveles avanzados. Registro: neutro, ubicuo desde escuela primaria hasta boardroom.
examples: Pay attention to the details in section three — that's where most people get tripped up. → aviso pedagogico
Please pay attention during the safety briefing before we begin the exercise. → contexto formal

questions.prompt: En una encuesta de satisfaccion tienes que marcar tu nivel de acuerdo con una afirmacion.
questions.question: Which adverb best collocates with 'agree' in formal surveys?
options: strongly agree — native collocation used in Likert scales.
highly agree — sounds unnatural to natives.
questions.explanation: 'Strongly agree' es la colocacion estandar en Likert scales, surveys academicos y discurso formal — aparece en cada encuesta profesional en anglo. 'Highly' se combina con adjetivos ('highly qualified', 'highly likely') pero no con 'agree'. 'Very' NUNCA se usa directamente con verbos ('very agree' es error gramatical basico). Error hispano tipico: calcar 'muy de acuerdo' como 'very agree'. La familia correcta: strongly agree/disagree, somewhat agree/disagree, neither.
examples: I strongly agree with the proposal — it addresses the root cause, not just symptoms. → registro deliberativo
Most respondents strongly agreed with the proposed policy change (72% in the survey). → registro academico

questions.text: The proposal has gained widespread support and is expected to have a lasting impact on the industry.
questions.explanation: Tres colocaciones nativas de alto registro: 'gain support', 'widespread support', 'have a lasting impact'. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'gained widespread' con /dw/ cluster, la /d/ final tiende a debilitarse. 'Lasting impact' se pronuncia como unidad rítmica /ˈlɑːstɪŋˈɪmpækt/. Colocacion clave: 'lasting impact' es preferido sobre 'long impact' (calco); tambien 'long-lasting impact' funciona con guion. Registro: analitico-corporativo, comun en policy y strategy documents.
examples: The reform has gained bipartisan support — unusual for anything touching healthcare. → politica
The talk had a lasting impact on how I lead my team, even three years later. → autobiografico

questions.prompt: Cierras el trimestre con la revision de objetivos con tu manager.
questions.question: Which verb pairs naturally with 'objectives'?
questions.explanation: 'Achieve objectives/goals/targets' es la colocacion natural en performance reviews y OKRs. 'Meet objectives' tambien es valido (mas modesto: cumplir minimos). 'Do objectives' es calco directo del espanol 'hacer objetivos', no funciona. Registro: corporate-formal, ubicuo en HR y management. Familia extendida: 'set objectives' (fijar), 'exceed objectives' (superar), 'fall short of objectives' (no cumplir). Error hispano: elegir 'get' porque en espanol 'conseguir' funciona — en anglo 'achieve' es preferido.
examples: We're on track to achieve our quarterly objectives, though Q4 will be tight. → forecast honesto
The team achieved all its stretch goals — even the ones we thought were aspirational. → sobrecumplimiento

questions.statement: 'Draw a conclusion' and 'reach a conclusion' are both acceptable collocations.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. Ambos ubicuos en registro academico y profesional. Matiz sutil: 'draw a conclusion' sugiere INFERIR de la evidencia (metafora de extraer, como agua de un pozo); 'reach a conclusion' sugiere LLEGAR despues de un proceso deliberativo. En papers cientificos abundan 'draw firm conclusions'; en committee minutes abundan 'reach a conclusion'. Registro: formal-academico. Alternativa mas fuerte: 'come to a conclusion' (similar a 'reach'). Error hispano: 'get a conclusion' es incorrecto.
examples: It's too early to draw firm conclusions from a sample this small — we need more data. → cautela academica
The committee reached its conclusion after weeks of review and multiple hearings. → deliberacion formal

questions.target: We've made significant progress, met our targets, and gained the trust of key partners — now we set our sights on the next milestone.
questions.explanation: Cinco colocaciones nativas encadenadas en una frase: 'make progress', 'meet targets', 'gain trust', 'set sights on', 'reach milestone'. Discurso ejecutivo tipo QBR (Quarterly Business Review). Ritmo natural: pausas breves tras cada logro, pausa marcada tras el guion, tono ascendente y firme en 'next milestone'. Contracciones: 'we've' obligatorias. 'Set sights on' es metafora de tiro (fijar mira en un objetivo) — muy natural en discurso corporativo. Registro: liderazgo ejecutivo, tono confidence + humility.
examples: We've achieved milestones and gained trust — now we scale to the next 100 customers. → transicion a growth
Steady progress, targets met, and momentum building — that's the story of the quarter. → resumen ejecutivo
